title: Portable Driver Triage — fingerprints.jsonl row
description: One JSON document per line in reports/fingerprints.jsonl. The cheap, pefile-only L1 pass computed on every collected driver (normally inside collection), BEFORE any expensive DrvEye deep analysis. Carries the import-derived signals that decide whether a driver is worth the deep stage: dangerous imports, imphash clone hits, and the cross-profile scope_matches. Append-only; readers dedup by sha256 keeping the most recent detected_at. A driver qualifying here is what pipeline.analyze --from-fingerprints selects for deep analysis.

imphash.description: PE import hash (lower-case hex), or null when the import table is absent/unreadable. Drives imphash-family clone matching.

original_name.description: Filename as seen when the driver was collected. Null when unknown (e.g. a corpus backfill keyed only by sha256).

signature_status.description: Best-effort Authenticode status from collection. 'unknown' when no signing tool was available (e.g. the Linux container).

dangerous_imports.description: Imported symbols present in refs/dangerous_imports.yaml. Import-table only — no disassembly.

clone_hits.description: Offline matches (sha256-exact or imphash-family) against the local LOLDrivers snapshot.

scope_matches.description: Every scope profile whose must_have_one gate fires for this driver, with the import-driven rank (a lower bound: ioctl/method terms need the deep stage). This is the cross-scope triage surface.

qualifies.description: True if the driver matched any scope OR had any clone hit — i.e. is worth the deep stage.
